episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Detective Yeonghan's capture of the gang's second-in-command, Salmosa, sparks chaos at the station.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Yeonghan recruits to Unit 1 the fiery Sangsun, the mighty Gyeonghwan, and the elite Hojeong.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Yeonghan warns of robbers heading to Seoul, but Senior Superintendent Choi dismisses his concerns.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Yeonghan suspects the orphanage director's involvement while delving into a missing infant case.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Devastated by the sudden death, Yeonghan sets a trap to apprehend the prime suspect, Viper.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: An officer falls prey to a sudden attack. Baek Doseok, a former military policeman, joins the team.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: A tragic suicide case emerges. Yeonghan leads the investigation and uncovers the hidden truth.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Two violent crimes occur overnight, and Unit 1 handles both cases due to the lack of personnel.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: A missing worker's body is found, prompting Yeonghan to suspect a group of influential figures.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Yeonghan discovers Doseok's secrets, prompting Doseok to hatch a sinister plan.
